title: Business Central 29: New ModuleInfo Properties Explained

chapters.title: What is ModuleInfo and New Properties
Version 28 Implementation and Accessing App Info

features.name: ModuleInfo help property
features.description: New property added to ModuleInfo type that returns the help link of a specified application, allowing programmatic access to application help documentation.

features.name: ModuleInfo ULA property
features.description: New property that returns the application end user license agreement link, accessible programmatically from AL code.

features.name: ModuleInfo privacy statement property
features.description: New property that returns the privacy statement link for a particular application, accessible programmatically from AL.

features.name: ModuleInfo context sensitive help URL property
features.description: New property that provides the help URL in the user locale for a particular application, enabling localized help access.

features.name: ModuleInfo type enhancements
features.description: ModuleInfo is an AL type that provides information about an application or extension, expanded in version 29 with four new properties for accessing app manifest metadata programmatically.

features.name: ModuleDependencyInfo type
features.description: New data type introduced for accessing dependency information from ModuleInfo, allowing AL developers to iterate through and inspect extension dependencies defined in app.json.

features.name: NavApp.GetCurrentModuleInfo function
features.description: AL function that retrieves ModuleInfo for the currently executing application or extension without requiring an app GUID.

features.name: NavApp.GetModuleInfo function
features.description: AL function that retrieves ModuleInfo for a specific application by providing an app GUID parameter.
